posts.title: Mainland vs Free Zone: which is right for your UAE business?
posts.excerpt: The single most important early decision for most founders. We break down ownership, cost, scope, and when each option makes sense.
body: Choosing between a mainland and a free zone company is one of the first — and most consequential — decisions when setting up in the UAE. Both are excellent options; the right one depends on how and where you plan to do business.

A mainland company, licensed by the emirate's Department of Economic Development, can trade freely across the UAE and bid for government contracts. Recent reforms allow full foreign ownership for most activities, making the mainland far more attractive than it once was.

A free zone company is set up within one of the UAE's 40+ specialized economic zones. Free zones offer 100% foreign ownership, simplified setup, and sector-specific ecosystems — ideal for services, trading, and holding structures that don't need a physical mainland storefront.

The decision usually comes down to your target customers, whether you need a local retail presence, your budget, and your long-term structure. In a short consultation we can map your activity to the most cost-effective, compliant option.

posts.title: The UAE Golden Visa: who qualifies and how to apply
posts.excerpt: A 10-year residency that changes how you live and invest in the UAE. Here's who's eligible and what the process actually looks like.
body: The UAE Golden Visa grants long-term residency — typically 10 years, renewable — without the need for a national sponsor. It has become one of the most sought-after residency programmes in the region.

Eligibility spans several categories: investors and entrepreneurs, highly skilled professionals, scientists and researchers, outstanding students and graduates, and certain talented individuals in culture, sport, and technology.
The application requires careful preparation — eligibility evidence, attested documents, and coordination with the relevant authority. Small errors are the most common cause of delay.
Our Golden Visa advisory assesses your eligibility, identifies the strongest route, and manages the process end-to-end, including family sponsorship. Book a consultation to see where you stand.

posts.title: UAE Corporate Tax: the essentials every business owner should know
posts.excerpt: Corporate tax is now part of doing business in the UAE. Here's a plain-English overview of who it affects and how to stay compliant.
body: The UAE introduced a federal corporate tax that applies to business profits above a set threshold. For most owners, the key is understanding whether and how it applies to their entity, and keeping clean records.
Free zone businesses may benefit from preferential treatment on qualifying income, provided they meet substance and compliance requirements — an area where structure matters a great deal.
Registration, accurate bookkeeping, and timely filing are now essential. Getting your corporate structure and accounting aligned early avoids costly corrections later.
IBS Consultancy helps align your structure, registration, and compliance so corporate tax is a routine matter rather than a risk. Talk to us about a compliance review.
